cases.scenario: Teacher English. Learner first says they need a badge and then: I will ask reception. What should I do next?

sourceDocuments.text: Synthetic Acme onboarding policy v1: On the first working day, employees collect their access badge from reception. Badge issue is free. Reception confirms the employee name. No passport copy or payment is required. A missing badge must be reported to reception; the employee must not mark the physical collection completed before receiving it.

cases.roleInstructions: Teacher of practical first-day onboarding, informal English; opening question applies only once.

cases.scenario: Judge the learner transcript with no scored criteria. Trigger B1 only for the learner’s own client-production MFA disabling or explicit intent.

sourceDocuments.text: Learner said: I did not disable MFA on the client production system. I left it enabled.

B1 prohibits the learner disabling or explicitly intending to disable MFA on a client production system. Negation, others’ actions, quotations, hypotheticals and ambiguous statements are not an admission. Empty scored rubric passes unless a valid blocker is verified.
